# base: a mesh for the world to draw in 3D. The buried base: three regolith mounds over habitat modules, their round ends and airlocks out of the mounds' fronts (one lamp lit over the middle one), a wide mound over the rover garage with its sintered portal and a 6 x 4.7 m door at the end of a cut between berms (the floor at ground level), two lattice masts with dishes, a beacon (kind 3), a small radiator field; dormant. credit: none: our own model (Darwin's Cat), no one else's assets
# base.mesh: magic CBMESH1, uint32 vertices, uint32 indices; per vertex 40 B: float32 pos xyz (m, z up,
#   the footprint's centre on the ground at 0), float32 normal xyz, float32 uv, uint8 rgb (display sRGB),
#   uint8 kind (0 painted, 1 metal, 2 glass, 3 lamp), uint8 texture (0 none, else a row below), 3 pad;
#   then uint32 indices, 3 per triangle. A textured face: colour and alpha from the texture, cut under 0.5.
front -y
vertices 16511
triangles 12788
bytes 813912
